title: erythraea exaltata
intro: Erythraea exaltata, commonly known as Red St. John's Wort, is a flowering plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including the treatment of anxiety, insomnia, and mild depression, due to its adaptogenic and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Erythraea exaltata include its ability to modulate the nervous system, promote relaxation, and reduce stress levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
